summary.business_type: B2B e-commerce wholesale (hybrid local pickup, Stockholm)
top_findings: No caching: debug cache:'no-store' + force-dynamic; every page ~1s TTFB and live WooCommerce calls
Pages randomly 404 or render empty (canonical to homepage) under crawler load; API errors mapped to notFound()
Wrong canonicals: wholesale subpages and /sv/shop/* point to homepage; translations point to English
Submitted sitemap.xml has no products or categories; two/three competing category URL schemes
Only 46 indexed vs 115 not indexed; 83 Discovered-not-indexed
quick_wins: Remove cache:'no-store' and force-dynamic, enable ISR
Submit a sitemap index including products and categories
Remove duplicated Product JSON-LD (fixes GSC Duplicate field brand)
Remove doubled '| Anmol Wholesale' from titles

findings.title: No caching on any page
findings.description: 297/297 URLs cache-control private no-store, x-vercel-cache MISS, median TTFB 1.03s. lib/woocommerce/api.ts:97 cache:'no-store' (debug), app/[locale]/layout.tsx:21 force-dynamic.
findings.recommendation: Enable ISR with revalidate and on-demand revalidation via WooCommerce webhook.

findings.title: Intermittent 404 / empty pages under load
findings.description: 8 product URLs 404 and 44 pages without H1 (28 canonical to /) at 6 concurrent requests; all 200 when re-tested singly. Product page maps any API error to notFound().
findings.recommendation: Only notFound() on confirmed missing item; rethrow other errors (5xx).

findings.title: Canonicals pointing to homepage or English version
findings.description: 12 wholesale subpages and 23 /sv/shop/* URLs canonical to /; sv/no/da category and post pages canonical to English.

findings.title: Sitemap omits products and categories
findings.description: Submitted sitemap.xml (52 URLs) has no products/categories; product/category sitemaps unsubmitted; /sv sitemap lists cart and soft-404 /posts.

findings.title: hreflang missing on 184 URLs
findings.description: shop, wholesale, about and translations lack hreflang.
findings.recommendation: Add alternates on all page types.

findings.title: Thin category and product pages
findings.description: 15/23 English category pages and 5 products under 300 words.
findings.recommendation: Expand to 300-500 words with buying guides and FAQs.

findings.title: Long and doubled titles
findings.description: 230/253 titles over 60 chars; brand appended twice; category titles untranslated.

findings.title: Duplicate Product JSON-LD
findings.description: Product schema output twice per product page; GSC: Duplicate field brand (4 invalid).
findings.recommendation: Single Product block with manufacturer brand, shippingDetails, hasMerchantReturnPolicy.

findings.title: Slow server response
findings.description: TTFB 1.0-1.4s everywhere due to no caching; no CrUX data.

findings.title: Missing alt text and og:image
findings.description: 253 img without alt; 82 pages without og:image.
findings.recommendation: Add alt text and default og:image.
